text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
âAh, lunch break is almost over. Shall 
we head back to the classroom?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, we've still got 10 minutes! Let's see— 
we could probably squeeze in a game of 
dodgeball!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! No matter how you look at it, that's 
impossible!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I'll be there in three 
minutes, so save us a spot!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go, Ruler! Game start!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. Challenging the "Ruler of the Board" 
to a match... are you? Well then? What 
game shall we—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"You'll understand once you get there! 
Come on, come on! Hurry up and follow me!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You two over there! Lunch break is over! 
Please return to your classroom!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"No, I need *you* to come! Right now, it's 
your power we need!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Me, Officer Fenomeno...? Understood, sir! 
Let us head to the scene immediately!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! You really gathered everyone 
in just three minutes! The court and balls 
are ready to go too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't tell me the game is dodgeball?! 
Epi, you totally tricked me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A game's a game. I didn't tell a 
single lie!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Putting aside any misunderstanding, it's a 
bit late to start playing dodgeball—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A 5-minute showdown, then 2 minutes to get 
back and we're golden! Right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, if you haven't broken any rules, 
then... No more beyond this—just please 
make sure you're strictly on time!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's decided! Now, let the game begin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia managed to pull off a match 
with only 10 minutes left in lunch break. 
Her brilliant pacing would prove 
invaluable in her races as well.
